provenance.evidence: CISA KEV (released 2026-09-29) lists BerriAI LiteLLM CVE-2026-59822 (added 2026-09-02, unauthenticated MCP endpoint flaw) and Langflow CVE-2026-9198 (added 2026-08-04, unauthenticated full RCE) as known exploited.

CVE-2026-59822.evidence: CISA KEV added BerriAI LiteLLM CVE-2026-59822 (improper authentication in MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint, unauthenticated attacker) on 2026-09-02.

CVE-2026-9198.evidence: CISA KEV added Langflow CVE-2026-9198 (code injection allowing unauthenticated full RCE on default deployments) on 2026-08-04.

decisions.story_title: YunoHost SOGo package auth bypass lets attackers log in as any user (CVE-2026-74864)
decisions.reason: Low-trust repost, but the claim verifies at NVD: CVE-2026-74864/CVE-2026-74865, sogo_ynh trusts a spoofable x-webobjects-remote-user header (or any Basic auth password) letting unauthenticated clients log in as any user including admins; fixed in 5.8.0~ynh9; CVSS 4.0 9.3/9.2.

provenance.evidence: NVD CVE-2026-74864 (published 2026-09-30): sogo_ynh forces requests with x-webobjects-remote-user to be treated as verified without password validation; Nginx does not strip the header, so any client gains access as any user; fixed in 5.8.0~ynh9.
